t: This is the former General Lying-In Hospital on Westminster Bridge Road, now a grade two listed building. Lying-in is an old word for childbirth, and this was one of the first maternity hospitals in Great Britain. It opened in 1767 and closed in 1971. Two people born here are named in the records. One is Tony Abbott, who went on to serve as Prime Minister of Australia from 2013 to 2015. The other is Arthur William Hobart, an aerial photographer.
